subject: Provisional offer: Senior ML Engineer — clauses, signing bonus & flexible start
messages:
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com
Cc: Sarah Lin <sarah@brightpath.co>
Date: 2026-05-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Provisional offer for Eleanor Park — initial draft and clause check

Team —

Thanks for a great loop last week. Eleanor verbally accepted our offer outline and asked for the formal provisional offer to review. Attached is Offer_SeniorML_ShortForm_v1.docx — it follows the usual banding (L4, band midpoint 220k, target comp within band) but I added a $25k signing bonus (one-time) per recruiting suggestion.

Two items I want legal/comp to confirm before sending:
- Equity vesting clause: candidate asked for clarification on 1-year cliff vs accelerated first tranche on partial months. Current template reads 4-year vesting, 1-year cliff.
- Start date flexibility: candidate requests a flexible start window (June 21 — July 5) due to relocation. We typically set firm start dates for payroll and benefits. Can we include a phrase that allows the start date to be adjusted within 30 days with mutual written agreement?

Monica, please confirm payroll enrollment cutoff implications if we use a flexible start window. Mina, is signing bonus approval in-band or do we need a compensation exception? Markus, any legal flags on the proposed language about start-date flexibility and the clause we add about background check contingencies?

I copied Sarah so she can coordinate final candidate expectations.

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Cc: mina_haddad@redwood.com, Sarah Lin <sarah@brightpath.co>
Date: 2026-05-11T11:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Provisional offer for Eleanor Park — initial draft and clause check

Karthik —

I reviewed the attached doc and left inline comments. High-level thoughts:

- Start-date flexibility: I'm fine with a one-sentence addition: "Start Date: The tentative start date is June 21, 2026. The Company and Employee may mutually agree in writing to adjust the Start Date to a date within 30 days of the tentative date." Keeps us covered for benefits enrollment but doesn't lock candidate to a firm date.
- Signing bonus: Candidate prefers the signing bonus to be paid on first payroll rather than upon completion of 30 days — fine with payroll but we need clawback language if they leave within 12 months (pro rata repayment).
- Equity vesting: Candidate asked if the cliff can be 6 months instead of 12; per policy we shouldn't change cliff for L4 hires. We can offer accelerated vesting only in very rare circumstances. Suggest we keep 1-year cliff and add a short explanatory sentence about typical schedule.

I attached a short text file (EleanorPark_Questions_Redlines.txt) with the candidate's items that Sarah forwarded. Many are clarifications rather than changes.

If comp approves signing bonus and legal signs off on the clawback language, I suggest we send the provisional offer with a firm instruction: "Please return a signed provisional PDF to indicate acceptance; full DocuSign will follow for final paperwork."

-L

Laura Bennett
VP, Talent Acquisition
Redwood Inference
From: mina_haddad@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-12T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Provisional offer for Eleanor Park — compensation band & signing bonus approval

Team —

Confirmed: candidate fits L4 band. Total cash (base + bonus target) is within band midpoint. Signing bonus request of $25,000 is approved on a one-time basis from hiring manager budget for this role, provided we include standard clawback terms. Specifics:

- Payment timing: pay on first payroll cycle following start; if employee terminates (voluntary or for cause) within 12 months, they must repay a pro rata portion (amount proportional to remaining months).
- Tax/withholding: bonus will be subject to normal payroll tax withholdings.
- Headcount: this headcount is authorized under FY26 hiring plan (HIRE-2026-ML-04). No additional approvals required.

Markus, please help draft a short clawback paragraph and a sentence around payroll timing for insertion in the offer.

Mina
Director, Total Rewards
Redwood Inference
From: Eleanor Park <eleanor.park@gmail.com>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah@brightpath.co>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-12T15:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Provisional offer — a few clarifying questions and preferred start window

Hi all —

Thank you — excited about the opportunity. A few quick clarifications from my side after reading the draft and Laura's notes:

1) Start date: I am aiming for June 28, 2026 but may need to shift to July 5 if lease logistics take longer. June 21 would be ideal but not mandatory. Happy to sign provisional to lock the offer and then confirm an exact start date within that 30-day window.
2) Signing bonus: I prefer the payment on first payroll — fine with a clawback if required. Would like confirmation that clawback will be prorated and only collected if I voluntarily leave in the first 12 months (not for layoffs).
3) Equity schedule: I understand the 4-year/1-year cliff policy. Would like the first vest date spelled out (e.g., first vest on 12 months from Start Date) and clarity on how partial months are handled if start date shifts.

I attached a short notes doc with inline comments on 2 minor wording items. Happy to accept once we align on the above points; please let me know if you prefer a signed provisional PDF now or to wait for the updated language.

Best,
Eleanor
(408) 555-0126
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: monica_patel@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: mina_haddad@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com, Sarah Lin <sarah@brightpath.co>
Date: 2026-05-13T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Provisional offer for Eleanor Park — send provisional PDF and DocuSign next steps

Thanks everyone — good alignment. Actions: 

1) Markus: please draft the short clawback paragraph + the start-date flexibility sentence that Laura suggested. Keep clawback limited to voluntary resignations within 12 months, pro rata repayment, and explicit carve-out for layoffs/reductions-in-force.

2) Monica/Payroll: confirm payment on first payroll and share estimated date of first payroll for a June 28 vs July 5 start. We need this so candidate knows timing.

3) Laura/Jordan: please send the provisional PDF to Eleanor with a note: "Please sign and return the provisional PDF to indicate acceptance; we will follow with DocuSign for final paperwork." Include EleanorPark-signed-provisional.pdf template if she returns it signed.

4) Mina: I appreciate the headcount confirmation. Please attach HIRE-2026-ML-04 to the final offer packet for audit.

I'll wait for Markus' language and then Jordan can finish the packet and kick off DocuSign (link above) — aim to have the provisional out today so candidate can sign.

K

Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
